title: England expects...
html_source:
A reference to Horatio Nelson’s famous message at the Battle of Trafalgar: “England expects that every man will do his duty.”

Nelson, a naval officer, lost his arm?wprov=sfti1) in battle, makes the one-legged sailor using his famous phrase to call for alms on a street named for him especially appropriate.
